svg.text: İstanbul GraphTraffic AI — from registration and feasibility control to frozen inference and public archival

text.tspan: • H1–H4 defined before confirmatory outcome access
• Primary endpoint: +1-hour MAE
• Model family, horizons, seeds and tests frozen
• January 2025 reserved as exploratory and excluded
• Official İBB CKAN metadata audited
• Infeasible seasonal windows replaced by 2024 candidates
• Metadata-only audit; no replacement outcomes inspected
• Hypotheses, models and statistical plan unchanged
• Four seasonal slots with deterministic candidate/fallback order
• Availability checked before traffic values were analyzed
• Eligibility required ≥64 locations
• Each eligible node required ≥98% training-period coverage
• Analyzable months: May 2024 and November 2024
• February and August failed the frozen node-coverage rule
• Minimum requirement of two analyzable seasons satisfied
• No outcome-driven month substitution permitted
• 64 nodes/month: 16 citywide anchors + 3 local neighbors each
• Selection used training partition only
• Directed OSRM road-travel graph, 6 outgoing neighbors/node
• Learned adaptive adjacency added to static road graph
• Identity-static + adaptive graph used as ablation control
• Temporal MLP vs Dynamic Graph Transformer conditions
• 24-hour history; +1h, +2h, +3h and +6h horizons
• Chronological 70% / 15% / 15% train-validation-test split
• Hyperparameters remained frozen
• Calendar-day MAE as paired inferential unit
• One-sided paired Wilcoxon + 10,000-replicate hierarchical bootstrap
• Holm correction applied to the secondary hypothesis family
• H1 not statistically supported: p = 0.5000
• Secondary results reported with multiplicity adjustment
• OSF registration + GitHub evidence archive + Zenodo DOI

svg.text: Workflow emphasizes separation of exploratory development, feasibility correction, confirmatory analysis, and result interpretation.
